guardrails: The original economy field denominator is 10 selected units: 9 persons plus NHN as one organization.
The 9-person career-scope metrics are a unit-type-specific secondary analysis and must not be reported as the full economy10 result.
NHN is tracked separately under the organization outcome architecture and is not assigned person Major/Apex/Advanced labels.
Baseline is lifetime peak through the 2005-12-15 selection cutoff, not merely the title printed on 2005-12-30.
Continuing the same apex role after T0 can establish post-T0 sustained_high, but it is not advancement.
박현주 score4 is based on later demonstrated global-scale founder/CEO scope rather than 2005 expectations.
황창규 remains score3 at KT chairman under a conservative anti-inflation rule; large-company chairmanship alone is not automatically score4 unless it meets the frozen apex criterion.
